ICS 97.150TXD 38New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies requirement for automotive non-woven floor carpet/mat to be used in floor, deck surface, seat back surface, trunk side, quarter trim lower and other parts of the automobile.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions, indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
